verdict.rationale: Elastic's marketing page claims users can interact with telemetry through natural language, and an AI SRE that investigates incidents, so natural-language querying and investigation is a first-party capability. The evidence covers only interacting with data, not operating the product, and there is no in-depth documentation or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can configure or operate the product (e.g., create rules, SLOs, dashboards or cases), detailed first-party docs on the natural-language interface, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
